QuestInfo.name: JM From tha Streetz in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: It looks like the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# needs help again. It's been a while, perhaps I should pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.1: The leatherworking master, #p401# of #m10003000#, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I'll need to defeat #r#o18#s#k and gather #b#t4000018#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to safely deliver the items requested by the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000#. At this point, wouldn't I qualify as a reliable partner?

0.0: Good timing. #p411# over in #m10003000# put in a request for a special item, but I'm short on the materials to make it. Think you could lend me a hand?

yes.0: All right. What I need are #b#t4000018#s#k. Has to be leather from those things, nothing else will do. What am I making, you ask? Heh, digging too deep into back-alley business can get dangerous. Let's just keep that part a secret for now. Anyway, hurry it up.

no.0: We're partners, remember? You didn't forget that already, did you?

1.0: Nice! This is exactly what I needed. Glad I asked you to handle it.

yes.0: Here, this is for you. I'll give you a #t2002008#. Use it and training your leatherworking skills should go a lot smoother.
yes.1: Though... this could be troublesome. Feels like #p411# is going to keep sending requests like this. Looks like I might be needing your help more often. Guess I'll see you again soon. Heh...

mob.0: Looks like you didn't take down all the monsters I mentioned. Are you really taking our business seriously?

item.0: Looks like you didn't manage to gather all the materials I asked for. Are you really taking our business seriously?
